name: @red-cup-engineering/abrash
description: abrash — a pixel/3D GAME ENGINE: a software raycaster (grid-DDA) over a federated voxel world into an RGBA framebuffer, a tick/realtime loop with NO global clock (aperiodic settling), AABB collision against the voxel grid, and a federated-trace WORLD substrate: a 'place' is a subject whose state is the FOLD of predications, unvisited = ⊥, disagreement = ⊤ HELD with both witnesses. THE BILATTICE READOUT in pixels: a ⊤ voxel renders DOUBLED and SHIVERING (driven by tick phase, not RNG, replay-identical), a ⊥ voxel is dim fog, an f voxel is a dark wreck. THE LAW: ⊤ held, append-only trace, evidence linear. Named for Michael Abrash (Quake's software renderer). Browser-portable: the framebuffer's RGBA raster is an ImageData-shaped Uint8ClampedArray a <canvas> can putImageData directly, and a headless build (Node, tests) reads the identical surface with zero DOM dependency.
